title: Orion Hit 39 Times the Speed of Sound. Its Heat Shield Held

scenes.text: A capsule with astronauts hit the atmosphere at thirty nine times the speed of sound.
Outside, the heat topped four thousand degrees Fahrenheit, hot enough to melt steel.
The shield is built to burn away on purpose, carrying the heat off with it.
After the first test flight, it lost charred chunks in a hundred and three spots.
On Artemis Two, in April 2026, there were nine.
NASA's analysis this month confirmed it worked. A hundred and three spots became nine.

description:
NASA's Orion capsule hit the atmosphere at up to 39 times the speed of sound on Artemis II, with temperatures above 4,000 degrees Fahrenheit outside.
NASA's post-flight analysis found nine spots of char loss on the heat shield, compared with 103 on Artemis I.
Would you ride this home from the Moon? Comment below.
first_comment: Artemis II came home at 39 times the speed of sound. Would you sign up for the next one?
